description: Grows the storage of a PostgreSQL instance to size_gb (larger than now, at most 1000 GB). Storage only grows: this can't be undone, not even by moving to a smaller plan. Each GB above the plan's included storage costs €0.15/month net, prorated by the hour; get_storage shows the current figures.

confirm_name.description: The exact instance name, as a guard against acting on the wrong one. Call get_instance first and copy it from there.

id.description: Instance id, as returned by list_instances

size_gb.description: New size in whole GB, larger than now, at most 1000

name: resize_storage
title: Grow storage
